Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.id

Class CompositeIdSupport

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.id.CompositeIdSupport
public final class CompositeIdSupport extends Object
Canonical introspection and wire encoding/decoding support for JPA Embeddable composite primary keys and CompositeResourceId types.

On the HTTP/JSON/OpenAPI wire, a composite identifier is represented as a colon-delimited canonical string in the declaration order of its components (for example, "1001:1" for (numfunc=1001, numvinc=1)), escaping literal '%' and ':' characters inside string components as "%25" and "%3A".

Note: Ordinary @Embeddable value objects used with @Embedded (such as LotacaoEmbeddable or EnderecoEmbeddable) are distinguished from composite identifiers so they remain structured JSON objects in DTOs and OpenAPI schemas while still supporting compound path navigation in JPA Criteria queries.
